summary: First Hawaiian, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing entry into a merger agreement to acquire TriCo Bancshares. Under the terms, TriCo shareholders will receive 2.095 FHI shares per TriCo share (stock consideration). The boards of both companies unanimously approved the transaction. The deal structure involves two steps: Merger Sub merges into TriCo, then the surviving entity merges into FHI, followed by a bank merger of Tri Counties Bank into First Hawaiian Bank. Equity awards will be converted into FHI shares based on performance achievement. The filing does not specify a premium, expected close date, or break fee. Watch for regulatory approvals and shareholder votes; risk-arb spreads may reflect integration complexity as a stock-for-stock merger of regional banks.
